notes.title: 「A列車で行こう9 Version5.0 車両キット 3nd」発売決定！
notes.content:
※Japanese Only

鉄道会社の社長となり、線路を敷いて鉄道を走らせ、都市を発展させていく「A列車で行こう9」は、おかげさまで2025年に発売から15周年を迎えました。
発売後も「列車ごとの個別ダイヤ設定」「列車の連結」といった新機能による進化を続けています。

この度4月24日に、車両拡張ソフト第3弾「A列車で行こう9 Version5.0 車両キット 3nd」が発売されます！
最新の新幹線から、近年増えてきた路面電車（LRT）まで、新たに18車両を収録。

「A列車で行こう9」すべての総収録車両数は、これにて343車両へ拡充されます。
発展を続ける「A列車で行こう9 V5」で、まだ見たことのない、新たな鉄道風景を実現しましょう。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/ca6ab35497d68c24427734643038d6c1138b2637.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/7f02a32b9b3947a93d1c453042e970a029aeef54.png[/img]

多種多様な日本全国の車両、18車両が新たに登場！

最新の鉄道風景を、あなたの街に！

新車両を展示できる「鉄道博物館Ⅷ」も収録。
圧巻の車両群を、ご堪能ください。

notes.title: Update patch version 1.0.1 delivered!
notes.content:
[h2]Additional Elements[/h2]
-Lights, whistles, head marks, and through doors can now be attached to the front and rear of intermediate cars and to the rear of the lead car. (Some cars may not be eligible for this feature.)
-The uneven patterns on the car body can now be painted with stickers.
-The “Ctrl+R” shortcut has been added to copy front/rear parts to the opposite side of the car.
-The shortcut “Shift+Left Click” has been added to select a range in the sticker list and BGM list.
-In the countryside of a trial run, the created car now appears on the turntable.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
-The sticker gap at the border of the car body surface has been made less noticeable. If you wish to reflect this in a vehicle that has already been created, please go to Vehicle Development > Paint and then overwrite the saved data.
-If you do not have a save data folder (document folder), a folder will be created for you. If you can no longer see your saved data in the game, please copy the saved data to the specified location by performing the operations described in the guide. Please copy the saved data to the specified location.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3387670587]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3387670587[/url]
-The frontal misalignment of the “Express Type (Widened) 2” model has been corrected. If you are concerned about it, please readjust it.
-Fixed a problem that the head mark sometimes disappears after saving when the head mark is placed under the car body.
-Fixed a problem in which a headmark would disappear after saving when the headmark was placed under the car body.
-Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Introducing the list of parts to equip the vehicle body.🚃
notes.content:
Today, we introduce parts that can be used for vehicle customization!
With our full lineup, you can create a vehicle with a 360-degree focus.


[h2]Skirt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/9752fcd7b6a6ee4bb1c8d19c5811b87112da475c.png[/img]
This is an obstruction barrier to prevent obstacles on the tracks from being caught in the wheels.
Even the same car body can give a very different impression depending on the shape of the skirt. You can also choose to have the skirt removed.


[h2]Light[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/ee185f677af4f36fe41ce887a1e3be56e52a2502.png[/img]
Lights, which are essential to the design of a vehicle's face, are available in a wide variety, from three-dimensional lights to lights that follow the body of the vehicle, and even bug-eyes.
If you add more lights, you can create a bizarre vehicle that stands out at night.


[h2]Horn, Headmarks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/e4638c904e91d211623a8024153f970f2b9fdc9f.png[/img]
The horn and headmarks bring out the individuality of the face of the train.
The horn is an old-fashioned device that makes a sound with air pressure. The headmarks can be individually painted to create an original design.


[h2]Pantograph, Air Conditioner[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/8e69cf720ace974f21776776a01dc62bd6852675.png[/img]
The pantograph can also be selected to be folded.
Pantographs and air conditioning units are parts that show changes from era to era as improvements are made.
Trains may tell its history not on the back ...... but on the top.


[h2]Underfloor Equipment, Fall Prevention Fences,Gangway Connections[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/a4c28ce202825c9c5b86a0661c3005b686174656.png[/img]
Even a single type of small part between the train and under the floor represents the characteristics of the vehicle.
Although these parts are not visible from the front, try to select them one by one while imagining the environment in which the car will run and its intended use.


[h2]Chimney, Smoke Deflectors, Sand Box, Ceiling Equipment, Grip Bar[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/0338f465ee6af32b1361db870a23d8eaa9bdafe5.png[/img]
Steam locomotives can also be customized with special parts.
Each of the large and powerful parts is packed with ingenuity to make good use of the heat and smoke unique to steam engines.





This is the end of the parts introduction.
The list of vehicle bodies that can be customized is also available! Check it out too!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2447420/view/4598826212610532570?l=japanese

We hope that the combination of car bodies and parts has given you some ideas for the vehicles you want to build ✨.
We will keep you updated on the latest information about "A-Train9 TRAINCONSTRUCTION" here!


[h2]Wishlist campaign is underway![/h2]
We are now running a wishlist campaign for “Let's Go on A-Train9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION” .
Original goods will be given away depending on the number of registrations!
Next, we will distribute original material paper crafts upon reaching 5,000 registrations.
Even if you are not sure about purchasing the product, there is no harm in registering for the wishlist. We are looking forward to your registration!

1,000 Wishlists: Fankit (icons, banners, wallpapers)
3,000 Wishlists: Calendars (*only Japanese version)

10,000 Wishlists: Series soundtrack on sale (39 songs)

notes.title: Introducing the list of vehicle bodies that can be customized!🚋
notes.content:
Today we introduce the types of vehicles that can be customised in "A-Train9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION"!
Have a look and imagine what kind of vehicles you can build!


[h2]Passenger train (head car)[/h2]
[previewyoutube=8kGcNZU3hTU;full][/previewyoutube]
These are familiar bodies for commuter trains. This is a collection of box-shaped vehicle bodies specialising in transport capacity. We also have articulated bogies, which are rare to see in real life.
The simplicity of the model makes the detailed workmanship in customisation stand out.



[h2]Railcar[/h2]
[previewyoutube=WSCED2Sc7DE;full][/previewyoutube]
you can build a single train with a driver's seat on both sides of one car.
As the train is completed in one car, it is recommended to start by building this body first.



[h2]Limited Express[/h2]
[previewyoutube=pd-_59VAJHc;full][/previewyoutube]
Depending on the concept, express trains can make a particularly big difference to the shape of the vehicle body and to the wrapping. How to make the most of the vehicle body is a test of your skills as a designer.



[h2]Middle car[/h2]
[previewyoutube=lzKkPvT43jQ;full][/previewyoutube]
These vehicle bodies can be used as Limited Express trains and Passenger trains.
Although it has no face and appears to have little room for customisation, there are many points where you can put your particular attention, such as the fall-preventing top, parts such as the air-conditioning unit, and the arrangement of the windows and doors.


[h2]Locomotive[/h2]
[previewyoutube=NkuHjT0e6iE;full][/previewyoutube]
This category of electric locomotives is mainly used for freight transport.
For presidents who have played the "A-Train" series, these may be familiar vehicle bodies for transporting materials.



[h2]Steam Locomotive[/h2]
[previewyoutube=bOFzLcjJPug;full][/previewyoutube]
The romantic SL is still a very popular vehicle for sightseeing. You can also make caboose cars, which were indispensable in the past. The smoke that rises from the chimney when the train is running is also a must-see.



[h2]Freight/Passenger Car[/h2]
[previewyoutube=wyDtrhPhkGM;full][/previewyoutube]
This is a category of vehicles without motive power.
Containers, familiar from the "A-Train" series, can also be freely painted in this title.
Customise them to match the locomotive or steam locomotive you are towing.


[h2]Super Express[/h2]
[previewyoutube=uC8lIy_3iMc;full][/previewyoutube]
The distinctive nose shape is a crystallization of the technological expertise of the time, created through repeated trial and error to reduce aerodynamic drag.
Choose your favorite shape from the following: round nose, streamlined nose, platypus shape and so on!



[h2]Tram[/h2]
[previewyoutube=tLj39EP2Mac;full][/previewyoutube]
Compared to other car bodies, the length of the car body is about half that of other car bodies.
We have a wide range of car bodies from the old-fashioned streetcar to the LRV-like car bodies that have been the talk of the town in recent years.





In the next issue, we will introduce parts that can be attached to the car body!
We will keep you updated on the latest news of "A-Train9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION" here!

[previewyoutube=lxMm5G64rrE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Decorate your city with customizable trains and vehicles[/h2]
Everybody has had a dream train car that they have imagined in their head at some point. Now is the time to bring that train car to life!

With A-Train 9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION, you can now design every detail from the shape and paint to the smallest details of your dream train.

Run the trains you have created on your map, take photos and share them with other users - The possibilities for your railway vehicles are endless.

Whether you want to realize the train from your imagination, or recreate the train that you have always dreamed of, this 3D railway vehicle customization software can make it come to reality.

Create and run your very own train!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/7c70c237e22ca4f9d74a5131e42abb1b05823829.png[/img]



[h2]Customize a wide variety of vehicles and components[/h2]
Choose your favorite vehicle body shape and parts and start customizing your vehicle. A rich lineup that allows you to pay attention to even the smallest details in 360 degrees.

There are 65 types of body shapes with a variety of uses from a variety of eras, such as box shape for transportation capacity or a streamlined shape for speed. The following 13 types of parts can be customized to allow for a wide range of creativity.

・Lights (sizes adjustable)
・Obstacle Deflectors
・Horns
・Air Conditioners
・Pantographs
・Head Marks (can be painted)
・Fall prevention fences
・Underfloor equipment
・Gangway Connection
・Smoke Deflectors (for steam locomotives only)
・Sandboxes (for steam locomotives only)
・Bells (for steam locomotives only)
・Chimneys (for steam locomotives only)

A wide variety of body shapes and parts will help bring your imagination to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/fd9e36a9332bbe86543eeda8101fc0211c9b5f3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/7b04ebbe32335890ceeacd0b2483c1487db6270b.png[/img]



[h2]Use stickers skillfully to create your ideal railway vehicle[/h2]
By using stickers, you can freely decorate the body of your train, and even create windows and doors to fit any style.

It is easy to create stickers, even for those who aren't good at detailed work.
By using Japanese, alphabetic and numeric text, or by using your own images as stickers, anyone can create designs and details such as destination signs and car numbers.

In "TRAIN CONSTRUCTION", you can even create unconventional designs that are difficult to find in reality!



[h2]Test Drive mode lets you enjoy your trains to your heart's content[/h2]
Choose a map that suits your train and begin the long-awaited test run.

Operate the map as the master controller to customize your test run! Control the speed, track divergences, stops and departures according to the train's purpose in order to increase the realism of your train.

In addition, use the photo mode to bring out the best in your train. Take the best shots that only you, the train creator, can take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/1304ab8b8454ad97a0cd0e9b236106c378e205e8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118262/889a0475e70ab5804a8c9779d984e6b6f8999104.png[/img]



[h2]The world of railway vehicle customization expands through community interaction[/h2]
You can share your vehicles with other users through the Steam Workshop.
Publish your favorite vehicles and aim to become a popular vehicle designer.

You can import vehicles created by other users and test drive them yourself. Even if you are not good at building your own vehicles, there are plenty of vehicles to enjoy.

Interacting with other users will add color to vehicle customization!
